meta.title: Prepare a two-step approval workflow for events with email approval
gaps: Open or edit the Approval Workflows configuration for events or bid proposals
Assign Asha as step 1 approver and Bikram as step 2 approver and save the two-step workflow
Verify that Asha receives the first approval email and Bikram receives an email only after Asha approves
Verify or configure the company's connected Outlook approval mailbox and email reply processing
Send an event for approval and observe the sequential approval transition
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Open or edit the Approval Workflows configuration for events or bid proposals; Assign Asha as step 1 approver and Bikram as step 2 approver and save the two-step workflow; Verify that Asha receives the first approval email and Bikram receives an email only after Asha approves; Verify or configure the company's connected Outlook approval mailbox and email reply processing; Send an event for approval and observe the sequential approval transition

args.phrase: Email approvals switched on for the company

steps.note: Configure the stated company-level email approval setting before attempting the workflow test.

args.phrase: Approval workflow for events with email approval turned on

steps.note: Configure the stated company-level event approval workflow setting.

args.need: open Approval Workflows, create or edit the event or bid-proposal workflow with Asha as step 1 and Bikram as step 2, save it, send an event for approval, and verify the approval emails arrive sequentially

steps.note: No catalog step can operate the approval-workflow editor, mailbox, or sequential email approval flow.
Final assertion that the session did not show an application error after the tester's intervention; this does not verify the workflow subject.
